correctness.rationale: The exact trace/Fourier model is a smooth connected (2,2,2) complete intersection with canonical series O(1). At each of five branch values the eight points have canonical order sequence (0,1,2,4,6) by an exact nonzero Vandermonde determinant, exhausting all 120 weights. Exact radical ratios place all points in E; irreducibility of U^4-U^2-1 and abelianity of Q(zeta20) give [E:Q]=16; Kummer sign permutations and the quadratic character of the cyclotomic automorphisms prove Galois orbit degrees 8,16,16. Standalone integer checker confirms all critical polynomial identities; it does not substitute for the mathematical proof.
